routeHint: Members -> open any member who is NOT the signed-in admin (the tab renders disabled on your own profile) -> Edit -> Permissions tab. Use Hugo Vargas (user 209196): he holds Secretary (HR_TENANT, COMMUNICATION_TENANT) and Chapter Leader (ADMIN_LOCAL), so the locked role-derived checkboxes and their orange role tags render in both the Organization and Chapter groups. FormPermissions.vue reads item.userRolePermissions, which Update.vue:1340 derives as user.permissions minus user.customPermissions; the demo seed inserted user_role rows without materialising user.permissions, which is why every checkbox was blank. user.permissions was recomputed from active roles for tenant 282 on 2026-08-05.
